bio.text: Kyle Brown, a Democrat, represents District 12 (Boulder and Broomfield counties) in the Colorado House of Representatives.
A vacancy committee of Boulder County Democrats selected Brown in January 2023 to fill the seat; at the time Brown was a member of the Louisville City Council.
Ballotpedia lists him as taking office on February 1, 2023, and as a candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election.
